reden: Yes. The audit report’s finding “Identical partial fills in one block collide on the rental order hash and double-count rentedAssets and escrow” describes the same root cause and code path as H-07. Both hinge on partial fills producing the same rental order hash, leading to multiple additions to rentedAssets/escrow while orders[hash] is a single boolean. Upon stopRent, the order is removed once, causing remaining assets to be locked and a second stop to revert with OrderDoesNotExist. The functions and storage touched (Create/_rentFromZone → Storage.addRentals/removeRentals; Signer order hash derivation) match, and the same fixes (add a nonce/ensure unique order IDs or disallow partial orders) would resolve both. The audit notes the same-block constraint due to timestamps, but this is a minor scenario detail; the underlying vulnerability is the same.
